review.reason: Connects cell variation to pack performance; methods and observational limitations checked.

item.title: Quantifying the impact of cell-to-cell inconsistency on electric vehicle battery degradation and utilization
item.headline: Uneven cell aging can leave usable battery capacity stranded
item.authors: Litao Zhou, Xiaolei Bian et al.
item.summary: Operational data from 116 cars and 17 buses link differences among cells to reduced pack utilization. The estimates depend on calibration and normalization of observational measurements.

evidence.question: How does cell variation constrain a pack?
evidence.limitations: Operational effects cannot be completely separated from intrinsic aging.

explainer.finding: Uneven cells can constrain the complete battery.
explainer.method: The team estimated capacity and resistance from vehicle records.
explainer.meaning: A weak cell can limit what stronger neighbors deliver.
explainer.limits: Model-dependent fleet estimates do not isolate every cause of degradation.
